messages:
Ivy: Quick heads-up  planning a small NPS+usage "fusion" backfill tomorrow 09:00 PT. Objective: ingest historical NPS survey text, run sentiment, write canonical feedback_sentiment and feedback_summary fields on accounts, and add a temporary outreach_cooldown to avoid duplicate nudges. Dry-run first 300 accounts. ETA ~50m.
Marco: Will this trigger any outgoing emails or playbooks?
Ivy: No sends. We'll set outreach_worker.enabled=false during the run and rely on owner-scoped cooldown tags so playbooks skip affected accounts.
Sai: Paste the sentiment pipeline and write rules so I can check edgecases.
Ivy: Pipeline snippet (dry-run preview):
```sql
-- join NPS responses to accounts, run sentiment off-platform and store result
SELECT a.account_id, n.response_text, n.score as nps_score
FROM accounts a
JOIN nps_responses n ON n.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE n.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '540 days'
  AND a.account_status = 'active'
LIMIT 300;
```
Pseudocode for write rules:
```
for each account in batch:
  sentiment = run_sentiment_model(response_text)
  feedback_sentiment = if sentiment.polarity > 0.3 then 'positive' 
                       elif sentiment.polarity < -0.3 then 'negative' 
                       else 'neutral'
  feedback_summary = truncate(summarize(response_text), 240)
  if feedback_sentiment = 'negative' and nps_score <= 6 and manual_renewal_risk is null:
    add_tag(account, 'renewal_risk:feedback_negative')
  if account.opt_out_feedback = true OR account.is_test_account = true:
    skip
  write fields: feedback_sentiment, feedback_summary, tags += ['nps_fused:3419999999']
  set outreach_cooldown_until = now() + interval '14 days'  -- owner-scoped cooldown
```
Sai: Add guard: do not overwrite manual_feedback_summary or manual_renewal_risk. Also skip accounts with gdpr_restricted = true.
Priya: Backup/rollback? If summarization or tags are noisy we need fast revert.
Ivy: Rollback plan: snapshot changed rows to cs_admin.backups.nps_fusion_3419999999 before mutating. We will also write a CSV of changed_ids to admin-s3/nps-fusion/3419999999.csv and store a small patch file with the exact updates in cs-admin/logs/nps_fusion_3419999999.log. Revert applies backup table rows per-owner.
cs-bot: Task created  CS-11011 "NPS+usage fusion backfill + outreach cooldown" assigned to Ivy. Dry-run id dr-3419999999. Window 09:00-09:50 PT.
Marco: How will playbook runner skip cooled accounts? Need a small playbook condition change.
Ivy: We'll add a short condition read by runner: `if account.outreach_cooldown_until is not null and account.outreach_cooldown_until > now(): skip_outreach_playbooks()` — runner already supports owner-scoped bypass for critical alerts.
Priya: Monitoring: watch playbook_fires/min (outreach), webhook_queue, support_ticket_tags (renewal_risk:feedback_negative) and owner_alerts. If >40 changes/min or unexpected webhook spike, rollback.
Sai: For quality, attach a sample of 50 fused rows (old vs new) to admin-s3 so product can sanity-check summarization bias.
Ivy: Will attach sample CSV dr-3419999999-sample.csv and ping product in the thread after dry-run. Plan: dry-run 09:00-09:10 PT, owner batches 09:10-09:40 PT, verification 09:40-09:50 PT, then revert outreach_worker.enabled=true at 09:55 PT. I'll post start/finish counts. :white_check_mark:
Marco: lgtm. I'll flip the runner mute and watch webhook queue.
Ivy: Kicking off dry-run in ~5m, will paste a 10-row sample output when it's ready.
